stem:
A student will spin two spinners in an experiment. The tree diagram shows all possible outcomes of the experiment.

Spinner 1        Spinner 2
1  ──▶ R
      ├──▶ T
      └──▶ Z
2  ──▶ R
      ├──▶ T
      └──▶ Z
3  ──▶ R
      ├──▶ T
      └──▶ Z

Which sample space is described by this tree diagram?
visual_elements: Tree diagram with Spinner 1 outcomes 1, 2, 3 each branching to Spinner 2 outcomes R, T, Z
